purpose: Holds a short, self-contained task or the details of a selection over the screen, then returns the person to the same place. It takes the form the window allows: a bottom sheet on a phone, a side sheet on a tablet, a dialog on a wide screen.
anatomy: Scrim — the veil over the screen behind it (required)
Grabber — a bar at the top of the bottom sheet; a button that changes its height (required at Narrow)
Header — Cancel on the leading edge, the title, Done on the trailing edge; or the title and Close (required)
Body — the content, scrolling when tall (required)
Footer — more actions pinned to the bottom (optional)

behavior.pointer: Cancel, Close and a click on the scrim run `onClose`; Done runs `onDone`. Pressing the grabber moves between the medium and large heights; dragging it up opens the large height, dragging it down returns to the medium height or closes the sheet.
behavior.keyboard: Escape runs `onClose` unless `dismissible` is false. Tab and Shift+Tab cycle inside the sheet. Enter or Space on the grabber changes the height.
behavior.focus: Focus moves to `initialFocus`, else the first control in the body, else the first footer action. It is trapped and returns to the opener.
behavior.responsive: Narrow (under 600px): a bottom sheet at the medium height (about half the window) or the large height. Medium (600–839px): a side sheet, the Drawer. Wide: a dialog, unless the caller shows a pane there (SidePanel). `form` fixes one form.
behavior.motion: The bottom sheet rises and fades in at --plx-sys-motion-duration-base.
behavior.loading: No loading state of its own. Show Spinner or Skeleton in the body.
behavior.error: No error state of its own. Show a Notice or field errors in the body.

a11y.name: aria-labelledby the title; aria-describedby the description when given. Close is named by `closeLabel`; the grabber by its action (Expand sheet, Shrink sheet).
a11y.announce: role="dialog" with aria-modal="true", announced with its title when focus moves in.
a11y.focus: Focus stays inside. Controls show the standard focus ring; the grabber shows it around its target.
a11y.contrast: It uses the overlay surface and the dialog chrome border roles, readable in light and dark; the grabber bar uses the strong border role.
a11y.motion: With reduced motion the sheet appears without rising.

content.labels: Write the title as a short noun phrase or the task in sentence case ("Rename collection", "Details").
content.actions: Show Cancel and Done (or Save, Add), or Back in a multi-step flow, never all three. Only one sheet shows at a time.
content.errors: Place errors next to the field that caused them; keep Done available and say what to fix.
content.localization: Cancel and Done follow the reading direction: Cancel on the leading edge. The title truncates on one line.
